lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
topic_title: Restraints, Open Truck Beds & Unattended Children
prompt: Under Texas Transportation Code §545.414, what is the age restriction for riding in an open pickup truck bed?

options.text: Illegal to operate a truck with a child younger than 12 years riding in the bed
Illegal to operate a truck with a child younger than 18 years riding in the bed
Permitted at all ages provided the truck does not exceed thirty-five mph
Illegal only if traveling on limited-access multi-lane interstate freeways
